task: KLA three-epoch loss ablation, six new arms plus reused same-budget control
control_reuse: Reuse the exact archived epoch3 commands; no retraining or neural inference
test_scope: Outcome-independent draw from the old600 model-selection validation, reused and not independent
wrms_definition: RMS wavefront in waves over surviving uniformly sampled pupil; remove piston and tip/tilt only, retain defocus at fixed original image plane
auxiliary_loss: unchanged: 0.05 inverse-pose SmoothL1 + 10 mechanical penalty, original invalid/path penalty
attribution_limit: Optical loss replacement also changes gradient scale and relative field/case/auxiliary weighting; no unique-cause claim from one seed; image-loss arms additionally use a recorded stochastic camera-gradient estimator
bn: Frozen running statistics; affine weights trainable
final_checkpoint: exact epoch3, no best-epoch selection and no per-epoch validation
primary_scoring: Original Q2000>=0.45 plus complete-path geometry and >=98% pupil support; grid129 with original grid257 borderline/disagreement refinement
secondary_scoring: mean and worst-field PT-WRMS at common grid129; casewise WRMS/Q agreement
baseline_reuse: Saved full3000 refined score/validity and grid129 WRMS, subset only
inference: One archived noisy packet, one neural prediction, no true state in network, no loop
prediction_difference_interpretation: USER CONFIRMED: predicted camera image minus actual acquired image
prediction_difference_status: Confirmed by user; replaces provisional pose-MSE before affected arms began
combinations: Fixed unit coefficients for included terms; additive, no per-case weighting or tuning on200
common_auxiliary: All arms retain original0.05 SmoothL1 inverse pose +10 mechanical; NO additional pose-MSE term
psf_history: Earlier PSF Hellinger arm failed; new P is relative squared pixel L2, not a repeat

image_consistency.estimated_pose: -network_command, estimates the initial misalignment; no true pose input
image_consistency.fixed_loss_scale: MSE in ADU divided by1024^2, matching original input scale; no per-image flux normalization
image_consistency.camera: Original fixed diffuser, exposure, PRNU/DSNU, degree24,2048pupil/4096FFT and original4096/8192 bandwidth fallback
image_consistency.derivative: Stochastic coordinate central difference h=0.001; random1of40 coordinate multiplied by40; includes complete boundary/carrier/phase response
image_consistency.field_sampling: Uniform one of9fields per training example per epoch, same draws across image-loss arms
image_consistency.loss_value: Symmetric average of plus/minus full-camera residual MSE; finite-difference smoothing
image_consistency.compute: Two full-camera field renders per training example, no new noisy acquisitions and no extra optimizer steps
image_consistency.limitations: Stochastic image-gradient estimator; variance and finite-difference approximation must be distinguished from loss-design effects
